messages:
Hannah (People Ops): Quick heads-up everyone — new mandatory micro-training and short attestation launching today. All engineers and product folks must complete the 25-minute course + 5-question quiz by Mon Jul 1 COB. Managers must confirm team completion in the attestation tracker by Tue Jul 2. Link + schedule: https://learn.redwood.ai/compliance/micro-2026

Marco (Eng): Clarify: is this replacing the annual privacy recert or in addition?

Hannah (People Ops): It's a targeted compliance refresh focused on SOC2/ISO changes since last year. You still need to do annual privacy recert if you're in the distro. This micro-training is shorter and required for a broader set of roles.

Rhea (Security): Quick security note: the course covers data handling basics for logs, secrets in configs, and access review best practices. Quiz includes one scenario question — read the checklist section carefully.

Marco (Eng): Can I do the course during work hours?

Hannah (People Ops): Yes —Managers should allow 30-40 min during the week. If you need a dedicated half-hour block, add the "Compliance micro-training" calendar event to your team calendar.

training-bot: Training assignment posted to your learning dashboard. Deadline: 2026-07-01 23:59 PT. Auto-reminders will be sent at 7d, 3d, and 24h.

Diane (Legal): A few legal bullets: 1) contractors on long-term projects must also complete the course; 2) any quiz answers that reference live customer data are disallowed — use the sanitized examples in the course; 3) managers should escalate any accommodation requests to People Ops.

Marco (Eng): If someone fails the quiz, do they retake immediately?

Hannah (People Ops): Yes — you get two tries. If you fail twice we'll flag it for your manager and schedule a short 1:1 remediation session. It's meant to be low friction though.

Rhea (Security): One operational tip: when you hit the training link, it will create a short attestation record in the tracker. Managers should verify the tracker entry (checkbox + timestamp) rather than relying on Slack confirmations.

Hannah (People Ops): We're running three optional drop-in sessions this week for anyone who prefers a live walkthrough: Wed 09:00 PT, Thu 13:00 PT, Fri 16:00 PT. Each session is 20 minutes. I'll post calendar invites shortly. :calendar:

Hannah (People Ops): Small accessibility note: course has captions and a PDF transcript. If you need alternative formats, DM me and we'll arrange it. :sparkles:

Marco (Eng): Nominally done  completed course and quiz, tracker updated. Thanks for the heads up.

Hannah (People Ops): Thanks Marco! I'll ping managers next week with the aggregate completion report. If your team is blocked by access to the learning portal, file a support ticket with tag "training-access" and CC people-ops.
